# evidence-policy

<!-- Generated by tools/config-reference.py from servlets/attestation-issuer/src/main/resources/META-INF/oidf-settings/evidence-policy.json. Do not edit: change the catalogue, then run python3 tools/config-reference.py. -->

The settings of the `evidence-policy` component of `servlets/attestation-issuer`, read by package `com.pingidentity.ps.oidf.issuer`: generated from its catalogue, [evidence-policy.json](../../servlets/attestation-issuer/src/main/resources/META-INF/oidf-settings/evidence-policy.json), by `tools/config-reference.py`, and checked in CI. [How to read a row](README.md#reading-a-row).

Under the production profile a violation by one of these settings refuses `ATTESTATION_ISSUER` ([components](../development/settings-catalogue.md#components)).

| Setting | Default | What it does | When it's wrong | Profile | Security |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `OIDF_ATTESTER_MAX_EVIDENCE_LIFETIME_SECONDS` (system property `oidf.attester.max.evidence.lifetime.seconds`, then env `OIDF_ATTESTER_MAX_EVIDENCE_LIFETIME_SECONDS`) | `86400`; seconds, at least 1 | The longest lifetime the attester accepts of a piece of evidence: of the whole (exp - iat) when it has an iat, and of what is left (exp - now, with 60 s for a clock behind the issuer's) always; a binding lives as long as its evidence, so this bounds how long a stolen token stays presentable. Production may only shorten it | **Doesn't start**: Not a whole number of seconds from 1, or above 86400 without OIDF_DEPLOYMENT_PROFILE=development: the issuance servlet's part is FAILED_CONFIG at deploy, naming the variable (before 0.6.0 each issuance answered 500 server_error from the first request) | Any | Yes |
| `OIDF_ATTESTER_REQUIRE_SINGLE_AUDIENCE_EVIDENCE` (system property `oidf.attester.require.single.audience.evidence`, then env `OIDF_ATTESTER_REQUIRE_SINGLE_AUDIENCE_EVIDENCE`) | `false` | Whether evidence whose aud names more than one party is refused: such evidence is presentable to each of them, so the attester cannot know it was the intended one | **Doesn't start**: Neither true nor false, in any case: the issuance servlet's part is FAILED_CONFIG at deploy, naming the variable (under development yes, no, 1, 0, on and off are read as false, with a warning naming the strict spelling); before 0.6.0 each issuance answered 500 server_error from the first request, in both profiles | Any | Yes |
| `OIDF_ATTESTER_GKE_SA_TOKEN_ISSUERS` (system property `oidf.attester.gke.sa.token.issuers`, then env `OIDF_ATTESTER_GKE_SA_TOKEN_ISSUERS`) | Unset; a list | The issuers gke-sa-token evidence may come from, space- or comma-separated: the GKE clusters' issuers, https://container.googleapis.com/v1/projects/PROJECT_ID/locations/LOCATION/clusters/CLUSTER. A token whose iss is not one of them is refused (invalid_svid); a client's attestation_evidence_issuer may only name one of them | **Doesn't start**: A value that is not an https URL with a host and no query or fragment, or a list of nothing: the issuance servlet's part is FAILED_CONFIG at deploy, naming the variable. Unset: under production every client of the type is refused (invalid_client, naming the variable, with one warning); under development any GKE cluster issuer of that shape is accepted, with one warning | Any | Yes |
| `OIDF_ATTESTER_GCP_ID_TOKEN_ISSUERS` (system property `oidf.attester.gcp.id.token.issuers`, then env `OIDF_ATTESTER_GCP_ID_TOKEN_ISSUERS`) | Unset; a list | The issuers gcp-id-token evidence may come from, space- or comma-separated: https://accounts.google.com, the issuer Google always sets on a service-account ID token. A token whose iss is not one of them is refused (invalid_svid); a client's attestation_evidence_issuer may only name one of them | **Doesn't start**: A value that is not an https URL with a host and no query or fragment, or a list of nothing: the issuance servlet's part is FAILED_CONFIG at deploy, naming the variable. Unset: under production every client of the type is refused (invalid_client, naming the variable, with one warning); under development https://accounts.google.com is accepted, with one warning | Any | Yes |
| `OIDF_ATTESTER_EKS_SA_TOKEN_ISSUERS` (system property `oidf.attester.eks.sa.token.issuers`, then env `OIDF_ATTESTER_EKS_SA_TOKEN_ISSUERS`) | Unset; a list | The issuers eks-sa-token evidence may come from, space- or comma-separated: the EKS clusters' issuers, https://oidc.eks.REGION.amazonaws.com/id/ID. A token whose iss is not one of them is refused (invalid_svid); a client's attestation_evidence_issuer may only name one of them | **Doesn't start**: A value that is not an https URL with a host and no query or fragment, or a list of nothing: the issuance servlet's part is FAILED_CONFIG at deploy, naming the variable. Unset: under production every client of the type is refused (invalid_client, naming the variable, with one warning); under development any EKS cluster issuer of that shape is accepted, with one warning | Any | Yes |
| `OIDF_ATTESTER_AWS_STS_WEB_IDENTITY_ISSUERS` (system property `oidf.attester.aws.sts.web.identity.issuers`, then env `OIDF_ATTESTER_AWS_STS_WEB_IDENTITY_ISSUERS`) | Unset; a list | The issuers aws-sts-web-identity evidence may come from, space- or comma-separated: the accounts' STS issuers, https://ID.tokens.sts.global.api.aws. A token whose iss is not one of them is refused (invalid_svid); a client's attestation_evidence_issuer may only name one of them | **Doesn't start**: A value that is not an https URL with a host and no query or fragment, or a list of nothing: the issuance servlet's part is FAILED_CONFIG at deploy, naming the variable. Unset: under production every client of the type is refused (invalid_client, naming the variable, with one warning); under development any account issuer of that shape is accepted, with one warning | Any | Yes |
| `OIDF_ATTESTER_AKS_SA_TOKEN_ISSUERS` (system property `oidf.attester.aks.sa.token.issuers`, then env `OIDF_ATTESTER_AKS_SA_TOKEN_ISSUERS`) | Unset; a list | The issuers aks-sa-token evidence may come from, space- or comma-separated: the AKS clusters' issuers, as az aks show --query oidcIssuerProfile.issuerUrl prints them. A token whose iss is not one of them is refused (invalid_svid); a client's attestation_evidence_issuer may only name one of them | **Doesn't start**: A value that is not an https URL with a host and no query or fragment, or a list of nothing: the issuance servlet's part is FAILED_CONFIG at deploy, naming the variable. Unset: under production every client of the type is refused (invalid_client, naming the variable, with one warning); under development any issuer on https://REGION.oic.prod-aks.azure.com/TENANT/ID/ is accepted, with one warning | Any | Yes |
| `OIDF_ATTESTER_AZURE_MI_TOKEN_ISSUERS` (system property `oidf.attester.azure.mi.token.issuers`, then env `OIDF_ATTESTER_AZURE_MI_TOKEN_ISSUERS`) | Unset; a list | The issuers azure-mi-token evidence may come from, space- or comma-separated: the tenants' Entra issuers, https://sts.windows.net/TENANT/ (v1 tokens) or https://login.microsoftonline.com/TENANT/v2.0. A token whose iss is not one of them is refused (invalid_svid); a client's attestation_evidence_issuer may only name one of them | **Doesn't start**: A value that is not an https URL with a host and no query or fragment, or a list of nothing: the issuance servlet's part is FAILED_CONFIG at deploy, naming the variable. Unset: under production every client of the type is refused (invalid_client, naming the variable, with one warning); under development either Entra issuer shape, whose tenant the token's tid must then equal is accepted, with one warning | Any | Yes |
| `OIDF_ATTESTER_MAX_CLOUD_TOKEN_LIFETIME_SECONDS` (system property `oidf.attester.max.cloud.token.lifetime.seconds`, then env `OIDF_ATTESTER_MAX_CLOUD_TOKEN_LIFETIME_SECONDS`) | `3600`; seconds, 60 to 86400 | The longest a cloud evidence token may be issued to live (exp - iat); a longer-lived token is refused (invalid_svid). Set, it holds all six cloud types. Unset, it is 3600 s for every type but azure-mi-token, which takes 5700 s: Entra, not the caller, picks a managed identity token's lifetime, 60 to 90 minutes, dated up to five minutes back. OIDF_ATTESTER_MAX_EVIDENCE_LIFETIME_SECONDS still caps every piece of evidence | **Doesn't start**: Not a whole number of seconds from 60 to 86400: the issuance servlet's part is FAILED_CONFIG at deploy, naming the variable | Any | Yes |
| `OIDF_ATTESTER_GCP_PROJECTS` (system property `oidf.attester.gcp.projects`, then env `OIDF_ATTESTER_GCP_PROJECTS`) | Unset; a list | The Google Cloud project IDs whose workloads may present gcp-id-token and gke-sa-token evidence, space- or comma-separated, each a literal project ID and never a pattern: a gcp-id-token email must be a user-managed account of one of them, a gke-sa-token's cluster issuer and a *.svc.id.goog trust domain must name one; production refuses gcp-id-token without it | **Doesn't start**: A value that is not a project ID (6 to 30 lower-case letters, digits and hyphens, a letter first, no hyphen last; a * is refused), or a list of nothing: the issuance servlet's part is FAILED_CONFIG at deploy, naming the variable. Unset: under production every gcp-id-token client is refused (invalid_client); under development no project is checked | Any | Yes |
| `OIDF_ATTESTER_AWS_ACCOUNTS` (system property `oidf.attester.aws.accounts`, then env `OIDF_ATTESTER_AWS_ACCOUNTS`) | Unset; a list | The AWS account IDs whose roles may present aws-sts-web-identity evidence, space- or comma-separated; unset, any account whose pinned issuer signed the token | **Doesn't start**: A value that is not twelve digits, or a list of nothing: the issuance servlet's part is FAILED_CONFIG at deploy, naming the variable | Any | Yes |
| `OIDF_ATTESTER_AZURE_TENANTS` (system property `oidf.attester.azure.tenants`, then env `OIDF_ATTESTER_AZURE_TENANTS`) | Unset; a list | The Entra tenant IDs azure-mi-token evidence may carry in tid, and aks-sa-token evidence when it carries one, space- or comma-separated; unset, an azure-mi-token's tid must be the tenant of its pinned issuer | **Doesn't start**: A value that is not a GUID, or a list of nothing: the issuance servlet's part is FAILED_CONFIG at deploy, naming the variable | Any | Yes |
| `OIDF_ATTESTER_AZURE_MANAGED_IDENTITIES` (system property `oidf.attester.azure.managed.identities`, then env `OIDF_ATTESTER_AZURE_MANAGED_IDENTITIES`) | Unset; a list | The object IDs (oid) of the managed identities that may present azure-mi-token evidence, space- or comma-separated; unset, any managed identity of an accepted tenant, its oid still required | **Doesn't start**: A value that is not a GUID, or a list of nothing: the issuance servlet's part is FAILED_CONFIG at deploy, naming the variable | Any | Yes |
